thread:
raul: follow-up from today's allocator sync. the 'quantum reclaim' idea reduced syscall churn but introduced short-lived backpressure spikes when many microbatches freed small pages concurrently. looking for pragmatic defaults and an ops-safe backoff.

emma: saw it too. with quantum=64KB we had better avg p50 but p999 increased with 95th pct concurrent frees. quantum=256KB smoothed p999 but increased per-request memory footprint and slowed small-alloc reuse.

theo: can we make quantum adaptive? e.g. pick base_quantum by resident_page_histogram and then apply a transient backoff if reclaim_qps > threshold. backoff policy: multiply quantum by 2 up to max_quantum, decay back to base over N seconds.

priya: agree adaptive. also add a per-node reclaim_budget (bytes/sec) so background compaction doesn't starve allocators. if reclaim_budget exhausted, mark reclaim_mode=throttled and emit tenant-level signals.

raul: propose defaults: base_quantum=64KB, max_quantum=512KB, reclaim_qps_threshold=200 ops/s, decay_seconds=30, reclaim_budget_bytes_per_sec=50MB. Also want a fast inline path: if page.last_touch_ms > 1000 and refcount==0 we allow immediate free even under throttling.

emma: also need allocator-side API: `alloc_hint(pin=false|true, expected_lifespan_ms=...)` so we can prioritize small transient allocations for aggressive reuse. Private customers can set `allocator.mode: deterministic|adaptive`.

priya: telemetry to add: quantum_bytes, reclaim_qps, reclaim_budget_used, reclaim_mode, inline_forced_frees. we'll sample per-node at 1Hz and aggregate.

theo: implementation note: reclaim should batch frees into a single syscall and coalesce adjacent pages by quantum. this reduces syscall rate and PCIe write amplification. ensure coalesce keeps page alignment semantics.

raul: YAML sketch for RFC appendix:

```yaml
allocator:
  quantum_policy:
    mode: adaptive   # adaptive | fixed
    base_quantum_bytes: 65536  # 64KB
    max_quantum_bytes: 524288  # 512KB
    reclaim_qps_threshold: 200
    decay_seconds: 30
reclaim_budget_bytes_per_sec: 52428800 # 50MB/s
inline_free_threshold_ms: 1000
```

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: infra/canary/quantum-reclaim v1 -> staging (job id 12877) :rocket:

emma: plan: run two canaries A/B with base_quantum=64KB vs 128KB for 6h; trace: s3://redwood-perf/quantum/2026-03-22.

priya: one more safety: when reclaim_mode=throttled we should also backpressure allocations for low-priority tenants by returning a light-weight backoff hint so SDK can retry with jitter. default tenant backoff ms=20 when throttled.

theo: i'll prototype adaptive quantum and syscall coalesce shim. expect PR w/ unit tests and perf harness tomorrow (PR #3712).

raul: action items: theo -> prototype, emma/priya -> canary config + dashboards, raul -> update RFC text. target: finalize defaults after 48h of canary.
